2.  This application has been filed for condonation of delay.

Though the delay is of 201 days, the Office has incorrectly pointed out the delay to be 231 days in terms the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. No objection has been filed by the State opposing to the said prayer for condonation of delay.

However, Mr. Panigrahi, learned ASC orally opposes to the said prayer for condonation of delay on the ground that delay has not been properly explained.
4.
However, this Court is inclined to condone the delay in presenting the Memorandum of Appeal.
5. Accordingly, the I.A. stands disposed of.

(S. K. Mishra) Judge 07.

3. Since Mr. Panigrahi, learned ASC for the State accepts notice on behalf of the Respondent No.1 and admits to have received copy of the Memorandum of Appeal, no notice be issued to the Respondent No.1.
4.
However, notice be issued to the Respondent No.2 by Registered/Speed Post with A.D. fixing a short returnable date.
Requisites be filed by day after tomorrow (09.08.2024).
5. Office is directed to call for the scanned copy of the LCR before the next date of listing.

6. The matter be listed in the week commencing from 16 th September, 2024 under the heading "For Hearing".
7. Tracking report of notice to the Respondent No.2 be kept on record before the next date of listing.
